subtitle.id: Apa yang kami berikan kepada pelanggan

description.en: Streamline your development lifecycle with automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and robust cloud infrastructure management.
description.id: Sederhanakan siklus pengembangan Anda dengan pipeline CI/CD otomatis, kontainerisasi, dan manajemen infrastruktur cloud yang andal.

overview.en: DASA DevOps services bridge the gap between development and operations, allowing your teams to deliver software faster and more reliably. We implement best-in-class automation, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code solutions tailored to your environment.
overview.id: Layanan DevOps DASA menjembatani kesenjangan antara pengembangan dan operasional, memungkinkan tim Anda menghadirkan perangkat lunak lebih cepat dan andal.

description.en: Automate your build, test, and deployment processes to reduce manual effort and accelerate release cycles.
description.id: Otomatiskan proses build, test, dan deploy untuk mengurangi upaya manual dan mempercepat siklus rilis.

description.en: Package and deploy your applications using Docker and Kubernetes for consistent, scalable environments.
description.id: Paketkan dan deploy aplikasi Anda menggunakan Docker dan Kubernetes untuk lingkungan yang konsisten dan skalabel.

description.en: Manage cloud infrastructure programmatically using Terraform and Ansible for repeatability and version control.
description.id: Kelola infrastruktur cloud secara programatik menggunakan Terraform dan Ansible untuk repeatability dan version control.

description.en: Gain full visibility into your systems with real-time monitoring, dashboards, and proactive alerting.
description.id: Dapatkan visibilitas penuh ke sistem Anda dengan pemantauan real-time, dashboard, dan peringatan proaktif.

description.en: Connect and synchronize disparate data sources into a unified, reliable stream of information for your business processes.
description.id: Hubungkan dan sinkronkan berbagai sumber data menjadi aliran informasi yang terpadu dan andal untuk proses bisnis Anda.

overview.en: Our Data Integration services unify your scattered data landscape into a coherent, reliable pipeline. We help you eliminate data silos, improve data quality, and ensure your business processes have access to accurate, timely information.
overview.id: Layanan Integrasi Data kami menyatukan lanskap data tersebar Anda menjadi pipeline yang koheren dan andal.

description.en: Design and build robust extract, transform, and load pipelines that move data reliably between systems.
description.id: Rancang dan bangun pipeline ETL/ELT yang andal untuk memindahkan data antar sistem.

description.en: Connect disparate applications and services through secure, well-documented API integrations.
description.id: Hubungkan berbagai aplikasi dan layanan melalui integrasi API yang aman dan terdokumentasi.

description.en: Implement validation rules and cleansing routines to ensure only high-quality data reaches your downstream systems.
description.id: Terapkan aturan validasi dan pembersihan untuk memastikan hanya data berkualitas tinggi yang mencapai sistem hilir Anda.

description.en: Enable event-driven architectures and real-time data processing with Apache Kafka and similar technologies.
description.id: Aktifkan arsitektur event-driven dan pemrosesan data real-time dengan Apache Kafka dan teknologi serupa.

description.en: Design and optimize high-performance database systems that ensure data integrity, security, and high availability.
description.id: Rancang dan optimalkan sistem database berkinerja tinggi yang menjamin integritas data, keamanan, dan ketersediaan tinggi.

overview.en: DASA's Database Platform services cover the full lifecycle of enterprise database management — from initial design and migration to ongoing performance tuning and high-availability configuration. We work with Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and other leading platforms.
overview.id: Layanan Platform Database DASA mencakup siklus penuh manajemen database enterprise — dari desain awal dan migrasi hingga tuning performa berkelanjutan dan konfigurasi high-availability.

description.en: Install, configure, and orchestrate database migrations and deployments to production with zero-downtime strategies.
description.id: Instalasi, konfigurasi, dan orkestrasi migrasi database serta deployment ke produksi dengan strategi zero-downtime.

description.en: Preventive maintenance, patching, and configuration management to keep your databases healthy and performant.
description.id: Pemeliharaan preventif, patching, dan manajemen konfigurasi untuk menjaga database Anda sehat dan berkinerja.

description.en: Continuous monitoring of database health, performance metrics, and automatic alerting on anomalies or errors.
description.id: Pemantauan berkelanjutan terhadap kesehatan database, metrik performa, dan peringatan otomatis pada anomali atau error.

description.en: Query optimization, index management, and resource planning to ensure your databases run at peak efficiency.
description.id: Optimasi query, manajemen indeks, dan perencanaan sumber daya untuk memastikan database berjalan pada efisiensi puncak.

description.en: Build scalable, robust applications using modern frameworks and industry best practices tailored to your specific requirements.
description.id: Bangun aplikasi yang skalabel dan tangguh menggunakan framework modern dan praktik terbaik industri yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan spesifik Anda.

overview.en: Our Development team delivers end-to-end software solutions — from requirements analysis and architecture design through to delivery and post-launch support. We build web platforms, internal tools, and integrations using modern, battle-tested technologies.
overview.id: Tim Development kami menghadirkan solusi perangkat lunak end-to-end — dari analisis kebutuhan dan desain arsitektur hingga pengiriman dan dukungan pasca-peluncuran.

description.en: Build modern, responsive web applications using frameworks like Vue, React, and Next.js backed by robust APIs.
description.id: Bangun aplikasi web modern dan responsif menggunakan framework seperti Vue, React, dan Next.js didukung API yang andal.

description.en: Design scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs with proper authentication, rate limiting, and documentation.
description.id: Rancang API RESTful dan GraphQL yang skalabel dengan autentikasi yang tepat, rate limiting, dan dokumentasi.

description.en: Connect legacy systems with modern platforms through custom middleware, adapters, and integration layers.
description.id: Hubungkan sistem lama dengan platform modern melalui middleware, adapter, dan lapisan integrasi khusus.

description.en: Automated testing suites, code reviews, and continuous quality checks ensure software reliability and maintainability.
description.id: Suite pengujian otomatis, review kode, dan pemeriksaan kualitas berkelanjutan memastikan keandalan dan maintainability perangkat lunak.
